title: PerceptRL: Making Visual Perception Rewardable in MLLMs from Answers to Interactions
abstract: arXiv:2610.37471v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Fine-grained visual perception remains a bottleneck during post-training of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), as perceptual errors can constrain gains from reasoning-focused optimization. Although image-caption pre-training improves perception, its influence can weaken as subsequent stages change data mixtures and objectives. Continuing caption supervision during post-training is challenging because subjective, information-dense descriptions complicate verifiable reward design. We present PerceptRL, which strengthens perception at two complementary levels. Perception RL uses a multi-agent pipeline to extract verified errors from dense image captions and convert the corresponding visual facts into QA pairs with fixed answer labels and rule-based rewards. translated_title: PerceptRL：让多模态大语言模型中的视觉感知可奖励化——从答案到交互
translated_abstract: 细粒度视觉感知仍然是多模态大语言模型（MLLM）后训练过程中的瓶颈，因为感知错误会限制以推理为中心的优化所带来的收益。尽管图像描述（caption）预训练可以改善感知能力，但随着后续阶段改变数据配比和训练目标，其影响可能会减弱。在后训练阶段持续使用描述监督具有挑战性，因为主观性强、信息密集的描述使可验证奖励的设计变得复杂。我们提出了PerceptRL，它在两个互补的层面上增强感知能力。Perception RL使用多智能体流水线从密集的图像描述中提取经过验证的错误，并将相应的视觉事实转换为具有固定答案标签和基于规则的奖励的问答对。其中，链式问答（Chain QA）用于关联相互关联的错误，而选择题问答则组合不相关的错误。此外，一条专门的路径针对高错误率领域采用定制化的验证，另一条领域无关的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: PerceptRL通过多智能体流水线将密集图像描述中经验证的错误转化为带固定答案标签和规则奖励的问答对（链式QA与选择题QA），并针对高错误率领域提供定制化验证，从而在MLLM后训练中使视觉感知变得可奖励化，弥补了单纯推理优化带来的感知短板。
en_tdlr: PerceptRL makes visual perception rewardable during MLLM post-training by converting verified errors from dense image captions into rule-rewarded QA pairs (chain QA and multiple-choice QA) with tailored verification for high-error domains, addressing the perception bottleneck left by reasoning-focused optimization.
